logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation: exact redelivery resolves the original result, a changed admission is a new identity

selectedContracts.guard: Exact open-request admission, complete frozen nonempty unique row set and population digest/version; amendments refer to a prior selection of the same population and later version. Materialize admitted selection after close without reopening request.
selectedContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.
